decisions.reason: Independent LED and sensor control makes the existing complete-rail LED shutdown behavior obsolete while leaving the rail's sensor-power behavior intact.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: I added independent control for led versus sensors, so we may no longer need the shifter.

decisions.reason: Independent LED power control does not necessarily alter the sensor-board connector matrix or its existing sensor power input.
The panel reset connector and EN-to-GND reset action are unrelated to LED and sensor power control.
The source changes LED power control, not the LED-board count or unresolved LED part selection represented by this Requirement.
Independent power control does not change the SPS30 SEL-to-GND connection or I2C operating mode.
The panel button and switch GPIO assignments are unaffected by the LED-versus-sensor power-control change.
The source does not change whether the PIR connector is provided or its digital input interface.
The capacitive-touch connectors, sensors, and GPIO assignments remain valid unchanged.
Independent LED and sensor control does not necessarily change the existing interboard 5V/3.3V connector topology or pinout.
Separating LED and sensor control does not remove or change the requirement to monitor both the 3.3V and 5V rails.
The source concerns LED and sensor power control rather than standalone USB operation of the 3.3V rail.
The source does not specify a changed interboard control signal, connector, or pinout; any such interface change would require additional evidence.
